18468716
WHAT IS CLAIMED IS:
1. A method, comprising: determining, by a processing node, a modified pickup time by a transport based on a conclusion of an event; and moving the transport to an intermediate location between a location of the transport after it has been parked and a modified pickup location at the modified pickup time.
2. The method of claim 1, comprising moving the transport to the modified pickup location when a device associated with the transport approaches the modified pickup location.
3. The method of claim 1, comprising detecting the parking of the transport at the location based on video data received from at least one camera.
4. The method of claim 1, comprising detecting the parking of the transport at the location based on a change in transport operation status.
5. The method of claim 1, comprising detecting the parking of the transport at the location based on a transport sensor indicating an occupant of the transport has exited the transport.
6. The method of claim 1, comprising receiving an agreement to move the transport from a device associated with the transport.
7. The method of claim 1, comprising determining the intermediate location based on one or more vehicles vacating a parking spot between the location of the parked transport and the modified pickup location.
8. A system, comprising: a processor; a memory on which are stored machine readable instructions that when executed by the processor, cause the processor to: determine a modified pickup time by a transport based on a conclusion of an event; and move the transport to an intermediate location between a location of the transport after it has been parked and a modified pickup location at the modified pickup time.
9. The system of claim 8, wherein the instructions are further to cause the processor to instruct the transport to move the transport to the modified pickup location when a device associated with the transport approaches the modified pickup location.
10. The system of claim 8, wherein the instructions are further to cause the processor to detect the transport parked at the location based on video data received from at least one camera.
11. The system of claim 8, wherein the instructions are further to cause the processor to detect the transport parked at the location based on a change in transport operation status.
12. The system of claim 8, wherein the instructions are further to cause the processor to detect the transport parked at the location based on a transport sensor that indicates an occupant of the transport has exited the transport.
13. The system of claim 8, wherein the instructions are further to cause the processor to receive an agreement to move the transport from a device associated with the transport.
14. The system of claim 8, wherein the instructions are further to cause the processor to determine the intermediate location based on one or more vehicles that have vacated a parking spot between the location of the parked transport and the modified pickup location.
15. A non-transitory computer readable medium comprising instructions, that when read by a processor, cause the processor to perform: determining a modified pickup time by a transport based on a conclusion of an event; and moving the transport to an intermediate location between a location of the transport after it has been parked and a modified pickup location at the modified pickup time.
16. The non-transitory computer readable medium of claim 15, further comprising moving the transport to the modified pickup location when a device associated with the transport approaches the modified pickup location.
17. The non-transitory computer readable medium of claim 15, further comprising detecting the parking of the transport at the location based on video data received from at least one camera.
18. The non-transitory computer readable medium of claim 15, further comprising detecting the parking of the transport at the location based on a change in transport operation status.
19. The non-transitory computer readable medium of claim 15, further comprising detecting the parking of the transport at the location based on a transport sensor indicating an occupant of the transport has exited the transport.
20. The non-transitory computer readable medium of claim 15, further comprising determining the intermediate location based on one or more vehicles vacating a parking spot between the location of the parked transport and the modified pickup location.
